tldr: 台股技術性反彈，收漲141點至47,111點，惟台積電法說後反應平淡、收跌20元至2,420元。
AI帶動的記憶體上行循環延續，第四季伺服器DRAM與NAND Flash合約價估再漲10%至20%。
國銀高資產財富管理規模突破3兆元，金管會並開放家辦顧問業務走出高雄。
美股週五收黑、那斯達克創6月來最差單週，資金撤出AI與晶片股，市場於10月28日會議前加大對聯準會升息的押注。
布蘭特原油盤中突破每桶110美元、為5月以來首見，因伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的攻擊升級。

items.title_zh: 台股技術性反彈141點收47,111點 收復部分前日跌幅
items.title_en: TAIEX rebounds 141 points to 47,111 in technical bounce after prior-day plunge
items.summary_zh: 加權指數收漲141.39點、漲幅0.3%，收47,111.26點，成交量約9,359億元，收復前一交易日逾1,656點跌幅的一部分。今日開高走高，盤中一度大漲逾500點、站回47,500點，終場漲勢收斂。反彈顯示市場情緒略趨穩定，惟量能縮減與尾盤走弱，顯示投資人在AI融資疑慮與通膨壓力下仍偏審慎，短線須留意高檔震盪與權值股資金輪動方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index closed up 141.39 points, or 0.3%, at 47,111.26, with turnover of about NT$935.9bn, recovering part of the previous session's 1,656-point slide. The index opened higher and rallied more than 500 points intraday to retake 47,500 before gains narrowed into the close. The bounce signals stabilising sentiment, but thinner turnover and a late fade suggest investors remain cautious amid AI-funding and inflation worries.

items.title_zh: 台積電收跌20元至2,420元 法說後反應平淡
items.title_en: TSMC slips NT$20 to NT$2,420 as post-earnings reaction stays muted
items.summary_zh: 台積電收盤下跌20元、跌幅0.82%，收2,420元，表現弱於反彈的大盤，尾盤並湧出約6,066張賣單。儘管公司公布第三季稅後純益7,630.6億元、每股純益29.43元同創新高，並上修今年美元營收成長預估，市場反應仍顯平淡。權值最重的台積電股價偏弱，壓抑指數反彈力道，也反映法說利多在前波股價已大致反映，資金短線觀望氣氛濃厚。
items.summary_en: TSMC closed down NT$20, or 0.82%, at NT$2,420, underperforming the rebounding index after its earnings call, with about 6,066 lots dumped in the closing auction. The reaction was subdued even though the company posted record third-quarter net profit of NT$763.1bn and EPS of NT$29.43 and raised its full-year US-dollar revenue growth outlook. The soft price action in the market's heaviest weighting capped the index's recovery.

items.title_zh: AI需求帶動 Q4伺服器DRAM、NAND Flash估再漲10%至20%
items.title_en: Server DRAM and NAND Flash contract prices seen rising another 10–20% in Q4 on AI demand
items.summary_zh: 研調機構TrendForce預估，第四季伺服器DRAM合約價季增約10%至15%、NAND Flash約15%至20%，AI伺服器需求使記憶體供給持續吃緊，部分受長約價格區間限制的供應商漲幅落後市場平均。SK海力士認為通用型DRAM供給將落後需求至2028年。漲價循環延續，有利台廠記憶體業者與AI伺服器零組件供應鏈的營收與獲利動能，惟須留意終端需求與長約價格對實際漲幅的牽動。
items.summary_en: TrendForce projects fourth-quarter server DRAM contract prices will climb about 10–15% and NAND Flash 15–20%, as AI server demand keeps memory supply tight. Some suppliers lag the market average because of long-term contract price bands. SK Hynix expects commodity DRAM supply to trail demand through 2028. The sustained up-cycle supports earnings momentum for Taiwan's memory makers and AI-server component suppliers.

items.title_zh: 台積電Q3獲利創高、上修全年美元營收成長 2奈米放量
items.title_en: TSMC posts record Q3 and lifts full-year dollar revenue growth outlook as 2nm ramps
items.summary_zh: 台積電法說會公布第三季稅後純益7,630.6億元、每股純益29.43元同創新高，並上修今年以美元計算的營收成長預估，顯示AI與先進製程需求仍是晶圓代工供應鏈的主要動能。2奈米（N2）製程持續放量、高效能運算（HPC）占營收比重居高，使產能、CoWoS先進封裝與設備訂單成為供應鏈2027年規劃核心，牽動台廠設備、材料與封測業者的接單與擴產節奏。
items.summary_en: At its earnings call TSMC reported record third-quarter net profit of NT$763.1bn and EPS of NT$29.43, and raised its full-year revenue growth guidance in US-dollar terms, underscoring that AI and advanced-node demand remain the chip supply chain's main engine. The 2nm (N2) node continues to ramp with high-performance computing a dominant share of sales, keeping capacity, CoWoS advanced packaging and equipment orders central to suppliers' 2027 planning.

items.title_zh: 金管會開放家辦顧問業務走出高雄 首波11家銀行符合資格
items.title_en: FSC opens family-office advisory beyond Kaohsiung, with 11 banks qualifying in first wave
items.summary_zh: 金管會開放家族辦公室（家辦）顧問業務走出高雄亞資專區，首波有11家銀行符合申請資格，被視為2027年的新成長動能，延續政府打造亞洲資產管理中心的政策方向。此舉擴大銀行高端顧問、信託與傳承規劃業務的可及市場，有助業者爭取高資產與家族客群，並牽動財富管理、私人銀行與信託業務的布局與競爭態勢，後續須留意相關子法與業者實際承作進度。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission is extending family-office advisory services beyond the Kaohsiung asset-management pilot zone, with an initial 11 banks meeting the application criteria. Regulators view the expansion as a new growth driver for 2027, building on Taiwan's push to become an Asian asset-management hub. The move broadens the addressable market for banks' high-end advisory, trust and succession-planning services and intensifies competition for wealthy clients.

items.title_zh: 壽險業2026年接軌IFRS 17與新一代清償能力(ICS)制度
items.title_en: Life insurers operate under IFRS 17 and new ICS solvency regime in 2026
items.summary_zh: 台灣保險業2026年起接軌IFRS 17與以保險資本標準（ICS）為基礎的新一代清償能力制度，自元旦起取代原RBC制度，並採四階段調適措施引導業者健全經營；保險業與擁有保險子公司的公開發行公司月營收申報期限，也由每月10日延後至15日。制度轉換推動商品設計轉向保障型，牽動壽險業資本規劃、避險策略與資產配置，為金融業中須持續觀察的結構性議題，影響獲利表現與財報呈現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's insurance sector is running under IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency framework based on the Insurance Capital Standard (ICS), which replaced the RBC regime from the start of 2026 with four-stage transitional measures. Monthly revenue filing deadlines for insurers and listed companies with insurance subsidiaries moved from the 10th to the 15th. The regime reshapes product design toward protection policies and influences insurers' capital planning and asset allocation.

items.title_zh: 國銀高資產財管規模突破3兆元 存款占比降破4成
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth AUM at Taiwan's banks tops NT$3tn as deposit share falls below 40%
items.summary_zh: 業界引述金管會數據指出，國銀高資產財富管理業務資產規模（AUM）至8月底約達3兆1,089億元、年增約七成，客戶數近3萬600人，已核准26家銀行辦理。這些投組的存款占比降破4成、來到39.4%，創2022年4月以來新低，資金轉向投資與保險部位。規模突破3兆元凸顯高資產客群需求強勁，並反映配置從單純存款轉向資產負債整合管理與多元商品，成為銀行財富管理爭取高端客群的主戰場。
items.summary_en: FSC data cited by industry reports put assets under management in banks' high-net-worth wealth business at about NT$3.11tn as of end-August, up roughly 70% year-on-year, with client numbers near 30,600 across 26 approved banks. The deposit share of these portfolios fell below 40% to 39.4%, a low since April 2022, as money rotated into investments and insurance. The milestone underscores robust demand and a shift toward integrated asset management.

items.title_zh: 凱基銀行私人銀行服務延伸家族治理 導入私募股權
items.title_en: KGI Bank extends private banking into family governance and private-equity access
items.summary_zh: 凱基銀行整合集團資源，將私人銀行服務從個人資產管理延伸至家族治理，並透過中華開發資本提供私募股權投資，讓高資產客戶得以布局私募市場。此布局反映台灣銀行業朝向為高資產家族提供涵蓋傳承、信託與另類資產的全方位服務轉型，在政府推動亞洲資產管理中心、業者競逐高端客群之際，私人銀行與家族辦公室服務成為差異化關鍵，牽動財富管理商品與顧問能力的升級競賽。
items.summary_en: KGI Bank is integrating group resources to broaden its private-banking offering from individual asset management into family governance, drawing on China Development Financial's private-equity capabilities to give wealthy clients access to private-market investments. The expansion reflects a broader industry pivot among Taiwan's banks toward holistic services—covering succession, trusts and alternative assets—for high-net-worth families, as competition for top-tier clients intensifies amid the asset-management-hub drive.

items.title_zh: 2027年遺產稅免稅額可望隨通膨調升 減輕傳承稅負
items.title_en: 2027 estate-tax exemption set to rise with inflation, easing the burden on wealth transfers
items.summary_zh: 財政部預料將依消費者物價指數（CPI）累計漲幅，調升2027年遺產稅免稅額，推估新門檻約1,478萬元（部分報導估1,486萬元以上），較現行增加約145萬元。以稅率10%估算，可為民眾省下約14.5萬元稅金。最終金額仍須以財政部正式公告為準，但此調整為高資產族群的資產傳承與贈與規劃提供更多空間，納稅人宜將提高後的免稅額納入年度節稅與財富移轉安排。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance is expected to lift the estate-tax exemption for 2027 in line with the cumulative rise in consumer prices, with estimates putting the new threshold around NT$14.78m (some reports suggest NT$14.86m or higher), up roughly NT$1.45m. At a 10% rate that could save taxpayers about NT$145,000. The final figure awaits the ministry's formal announcement, but the adjustment gives high-net-worth families more room in succession planning.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅改採擬制遺產課稅 財政部研擬子法與稽徵配套
items.title_en: Finance Ministry drafts sub-regulations after estate tax shifts to a "deemed-estate" basis
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過以「擬制遺產」方式課徵遺產稅後，財政部正研擬修正遺贈稅法施行細則等子法規，並同步調整申報書表與線上申辦系統。財政部表示，待總統公布修正條文後將加強宣導，以利徵納依循。新制聚焦強化對生前財產移轉的反避稅認定，牽動高資產族群的傳承與贈與規劃；實際施行日期與細節仍待子法與公告確認，納稅人宜留意後續法規進度與申報作業調整。
items.summary_en: Following the legislature's passage of amendments moving estate taxation toward a "deemed-estate" basis, the Ministry of Finance is drafting revisions to sub-regulations such as the enforcement rules of the Estate and Gift Tax Act and adjusting filing forms and systems. The ministry says it will step up public guidance once the president promulgates the changes, tightening anti-avoidance treatment of pre-death asset transfers while aiming to keep compliance manageable.

items.title_zh: 美9月通膨升溫 市場於10月28日會議前加大升息押注
items.title_en: Fed rate-hike bets build ahead of Oct 28 meeting as September inflation runs hot
items.summary_zh: 美國9月消費者物價指數（CPI）月增0.6%，通膨續高於目標，市場重新加大對聯準會在10月27至28日會議升息的押注。美銀以「聯準會有升息必要」作為其偏空（risk-off）立場的理由之一；市場並憂心借貸成本走高恐壓抑AI相關的龐大資本支出，加重股市賣壓。利率路徑重估牽動全球資金流向與風險胃納，後續須密切觀察當月會議結果與官員談話對美元與風險性資產的影響。
items.summary_en: Markets are rebuilding bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike at the Oct 27–28 meeting after September's consumer price index rose 0.6% month-on-month, keeping inflation above target. Bank of America cited the "need for the Fed to hike" as a reason for its risk-off stance, and concerns that higher borrowing costs could weigh on the heavy capital spending behind AI added to pressure on equities. The hawkish repricing is steering global capital flows and risk appetite into late October.

items.title_zh: 美股下挫 那斯達克創6月來最差單週（2026-10-16）
items.title_en: US stocks slide, Nasdaq posts worst week since June in AI-led rout (2026-10-16)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五收黑，標普500指數下跌1.09%、收7,659.44點，那斯達克指數跌2.14%、收26,140.03點，道瓊工業指數跌175點、跌幅0.34%、收52,002.41點。那斯達克100指數寫下逾一年半來最差單週，投資人避開晶片股並撤出AI相關標的。恐慌指數（VIX）升破20、創6月來新高，顯示市場避險情緒明顯升溫，反映對AI估值與融資成本的疑慮持續發酵。
items.summary_en: US equities fell on Friday, with the S&P 500 down 1.09% to 7,659.44 and the Nasdaq Composite off 2.14% to 26,140.03, while the Dow eased 175 points, or 0.34%, to 52,002.41. The Nasdaq 100 logged its worst week in over a year and a half as investors steered clear of chipmakers and rotated away from AI names. The VIX jumped above 20 to its highest since June, signalling rising fear in the market.

items.title_zh: 布蘭特原油突破110美元 伊朗荷姆茲海峽攻擊升級（2026-10-16）
items.title_en: Brent crude tops US$110 as Iran escalates Strait of Hormuz attacks (2026-10-16)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價走高，因伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的攻擊升級，烏克蘭並矢言打擊俄羅斯煉油廠。美國西德州中級原油（WTI）上漲約3.5%、每桶收約101.41美元；布蘭特原油盤中觸及每桶110美元、為5月以來首見，後小幅回落收約109.86美元、漲3.7%。美國截至10月9日當週商業原油庫存大減逾800萬桶，高於市場預期，進一步支撐油價，使地緣供給風險溢價持續推升能源價格。
items.summary_en: Oil surged as Iran escalated attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and Ukraine vowed to hit Russian refineries. US WTI rose about 3.5% to settle near US$101.41 a barrel, while Brent touched US$110 for the first time since May before easing to settle around US$109.86, up 3.7%. A larger-than-expected US crude inventory draw of more than 8 million barrels for the week ended Oct 9 added support, keeping geopolitical supply-risk premiums firmly in play.
